name: guardmarket
description: Discover commerce and data skills, inspect schemas and prices, and invoke with explicit spending limits. Requires an independently running GuardMarket backend.

interface.longDescription: Connect to your GuardMarket backend to discover versioned commerce and data skills, inspect schemas and prices, and invoke within a spending cap. Discovery is anonymous; execution and account queries use your consumer credential.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find a skill to calculate a cart total and show its input schema and price.
